strings.name: Volker Türk
strings.summary: Türk moved from refugee law and field protection into senior UN roles, leading UNHCR’s international-protection work, helping develop the Global Compact on Refugees and coordinating the Secretary-General’s policy work. Appointed human-rights chief in 2022, he addresses civilian protection, migrants’ rights and digital risks; some states criticize his oversight. The General Assembly approved another four-year term in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; reviewed on 15 November. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Has long worked on UN refugee and human-rights affairs, serves as High Commissioner for Human Rights and advances international rights protection and accountability.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Master of Laws, Johannes Kepler University Linz; doctorate in international law, University of Vienna.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Refugee law and protection
strings.highlights.h1.text: Long worked on UN refugee policy and field protection and helped develop the Global Compact on Refugees.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Global human-rights oversight
strings.highlights.h2.text: Leads the UN human-rights office; a General Assembly vote granted a second four-year term in 2026.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Renewal approved by General Assembly
strings.timeline.t1.text: The Assembly approved renewal by 144 votes to 10, with 13 abstentions, for October 2026 to October 2030.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Took up human-rights duties
strings.timeline.t2.text: Succeeded Michelle Bachelet at the Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Appointed policy under-secretary-general
strings.timeline.t3.text: Named Under-Secretary-General for Policy in the Secretary-General’s office, coordinating global policy work.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Appointed strategic-coordination assistant secretary-general
strings.timeline.t4.text: Joined the Secretary-General’s office for cross-agency strategic coordination.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became assistant high commissioner for protection
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became UNHCR Assistant High Commissioner for Protection.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Led international protection division
strings.timeline.t6.text: Directed UNHCR’s Division of International Protection until 2015.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Began UN career
strings.timeline.t7.text: Worked in Kuwait as a junior professional officer before refugee assignments in several regions.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Linz
strings.timeline.t8.text: Later studied law and international law in Austria.
